name: Tierceron
description: A tierceron springing from the wall to a ridge — a rib outline with a second inside it.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 8; scale: 0.98; frame: 9); clip-path: @shape(points: 8; scale: 0.98; frame: 9); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 22%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @shape(points: 8; rotate: 22.5; frame: 14); clip-path: @shape(points: 8; rotate: 22.5; frame: 14); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
